# Repository guidance

- This is a fork. Always target `matthidinger/matthidinger.github.io`, never the upstream theme repository.
- New PRs target `master`. Only Matt merges and publishes; never push to `master`, merge, or deploy.
- Jekyll site built by GitHub Pages from `master`. Do not modernize the old Gemfile or npm assets.
- Speaking content lives in `_pages/talks.md` (`/talks/`); keep its permalink and redirect. Blog posts are in `_posts/`, data in `_data/`.
- Never invent conferences, talks, dates, credits or URLs. Ask on the issue for missing required facts; omit optional ones.
- Keep `CNAME`, `_config.yml`, theme, URLs and redirects unchanged unless explicitly requested.
- Use only public information.
